rule.name: DV without HDR fallback
rule.when: dolbyVision and not hdrFallback

rule.name: Reject SAO II from SAO Season 1
rule.when:
isAnime
and kind == "anime_show"
and title == "Sword Art Online"
and season == 1
and releaseName matches "(?i)^Sword[. _-]+Art[. _-]+Online[. _-]+II(?:[. _\[-]|$)"

rule.name: Reject SAO from SAO II
rule.when:
isAnime
and kind == "anime_show"
and title == "Sword Art Online II"
and season == 1
and releaseName matches "(?i)^Sword[. _-]+Art[. _-]+Online(?:[. _\[-]|$)"
and not releaseName matches "(?i)^Sword[. _-]+Art[. _-]+Online[. _\[-]+(?:II|Alicization|Progressive)\b"

rule.name: Reject 3D
rule.when: threeD

rule.name: Known unavailable
rule.when: avail.status == "unavailable"

rule.name: Dublado PT (Audio PT Declarado ou Indicado)
rule.when: matched("PT Audio Indicado")

rule.name: Legendado PT (Legenda PT Declarada ou Indicada)
rule.when: matched("PT Legenda Indicada")

rule.name: Exclusao Nao Dublado / Sem Dublagem
rule.when: matched("Exclusao Nao Dublado")

rule.name: Alive on our backbone (Cache equivalente)
rule.when: avail.onMyBackbone

rule.name: Recently confirmed
rule.when: avail.checkedDaysAgo >= 0 and avail.checkedDaysAgo < 30

rule.name: Base UHD BluRay encode

rule.name: Base SD 576p

rule.name: Base SD 480p

rule.name: V20 Fonte SD identificada

rule.name: Base baixa resolucao 360p
rule.when: resolution == "360p"

rule.name: V10 Fonte desconhecida
rule.when: resolution == "" and not ("dvdrip" in traits or "hdtv" in traits or "hdrip" in traits or "bluray" in traits or "webdl" in traits or "webrip" in traits)

rule.name: Base baixa resolucao 240p 144p
rule.when: resolution == "240p" or resolution == "144p"

rule.name: Dolby Vision com HDR base sinalizado
rule.when: dolbyVision and (any(hdr, # == "HDR10+" or # == "HDR10" or # == "HDR" or # == "HLG") or hdrFallback)

rule.name: Dolby Vision sem HDR base sinalizado
rule.when: dolbyVision and not (any(hdr, # == "HDR10+" or # == "HDR10" or # == "HDR" or # == "HLG") or hdrFallback)

rule.name: Imagem HDR10+ sinalizada
rule.when: not dolbyVision and any(hdr, # == "HDR10+")

rule.name: Imagem HDR10 sinalizada
rule.when: not dolbyVision and not any(hdr, # == "HDR10+") and any(hdr, # == "HDR10")

rule.name: Imagem HLG ou HDR generico
rule.when: not dolbyVision and not any(hdr, # == "HDR10+" or # == "HDR10") and any(hdr, # == "HDR" or # == "HLG")

rule.name: Upscale de video declarado
rule.when: matched("Upscale Declarado")

rule.name: Audio lossless anunciado no arquivo
rule.when: "truehd" in traits or "dts_lossless" in traits or "dts_x" in traits or releaseName matches "(?i)\\b(?:FLAC|L?PCM)\\b"

rule.name: Audio com perdas multicanal anunciado
rule.when: not ("truehd" in traits or "dts_lossless" in traits or "dts_x" in traits or releaseName matches "(?i)\\b(?:FLAC|L?PCM)\\b") and ("dolby_digital_plus" in traits or "dts_es" in traits or "dts_lossy" in traits or releaseName matches "(?i)\\bDTS-HD\\b")

rule.name: Audio com perdas anunciado
rule.when: not ("truehd" in traits or "dts_lossless" in traits or "dts_x" in traits or "dolby_digital_plus" in traits or "dts_es" in traits or "dts_lossy" in traits or releaseName matches "(?i)\\b(?:FLAC|L?PCM|DTS-HD)\\b") and ("aac" in traits or "dolby_digital" in traits or releaseName matches "(?i)\\bOPUS\\b")

rule.name: Audio Atmos - desempate
rule.when: "atmos" in traits and not matched("Atmos Exclude Groups")

rule.name: Micro-encode com alerta
rule.when: matched("TRASH micro-encodes com alerta")

rule.name: Bad Dual (Neutro para Dublado PT)
rule.when: matched("TRASH Bad Dual")

rule.name: Hardcoded subs
rule.when: hardcoded

rule.name: Converted penalty
rule.when: "converted" in traits

rule.name: IMAX
rule.when: releaseName matches "(?i)\\bIMAX\\b"

rule.name: Open matte
rule.when: releaseName matches "(?i)\\bOpen[. _-]?Matte\\b"
